dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, where do graduates from this place go?

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: The aristocrats usually inherit their family businesses afterward, while the vast majority of commoners join the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: For the latter group, this is the best way to climb the ladder and gain merit.

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: It is the highest honor to sacrifice themselves for Her Majesty. It's just... some recent Fatui policies, and the manner in which some Harbinger operate...

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: ...Must they really take these children, freshly out of their graduation uniforms, to replace those lost to meaningless sacrifices?

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: Sorry, I spoke out of turn. Just consider these the pointless ramblings of an old woman.
